Hello,
I intervened yesterday on
station 5 – Via Julia Augusta (Scoperta), Serial Number MP/P9 170000998
, in order to clear the
FC23 fault
.
The charging station is now operational.
However, I noticed that
PDC1 does not work with my vehicle
: the connector goes into error immediately after plugging in.
I saw that a field intervention is already scheduled tomorrow,
03/10
. Could you please
adapt the intervention to include a full diagnostic of PDC1
?
Thank you in advance for your support.
Best regards,
Florian MURA
Ingénieur Exploitation IRVE
